intro: Evenings feel softer with Lewes. Wrapped in breathable fabric, its rocking recline, high back, and cushioned support turn everyday pauses into cozy escapes where you rest fully and breathe easier.

features.title: Recline that moves at your pace
features.text: A noiseless manual mechanism lets you lean back at your pace, unfolding the footrest smoothly so relaxation feels effortless and unbroken.

features.title: Rocking motion for calm relaxation
features.text: The built-in rocking mechanism gently sways you, easing away tension and creating a soothing rhythm for naps, reading, or unwinding after work.

features.title: Crafted finish with lasting appeal
features.text: Black fabric upholstery stays cool against the skin, making it comfortable in warm climates while offering a modern, versatile look. Refined stitching lines and superior fit make the recliner as visually inviting as it is functionally reliable, enhancing the mood of your living space.

features.title: High back and lumbar support
features.text: A tall, cushioned backrest with enhanced lumbar care supports your spine and shoulders, so long sits feel restorative rather than tiring.

features.title: Ergonomic square armrests
features.text: Flat, padded armrests give your arms a natural landing spot in multiple postures, helping you feel supported whether working, chatting, or resting.

features.title: Integrated footrest with ease
features.text: The footrest unfolds easily using the recline mechanism and folds back smoothly with your body weight, adding comfort that adapts effortlessly to you.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Lewes Manual 1-Seater Fabric Rocker Recliner
